title: Cognitive Maps in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.25596v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: It has long been proposed that animals construct cognitive maps to support flexible behavior in novel environments. We tested whether large language models form analogous internal representations using relational reasoning tasks and causal "mosaic" experiments. Models beyond the ten-billion-parameter scale inferred unstated relationships and generalized to synthetic entity names. Across models and tasks, models formed abstract representations of relational structure, additively combining them with representations of entity identity. Relationships were primarily stored as pairwise links and composed retrospectively, rather than prospectively encoded in a global coordinate system. A sparse, distributed set of key-value pairs mediated binding; perturbing them implanted "false memories" that produced predictable behavioral changes. translated_title: 大型语言模型中的认知地图
translated_abstract: 长期以来，有观点认为动物会构建认知地图以在新环境中支持灵活的行为。我们通过关系推理任务和因果“马赛克”实验，检验了大型语言模型是否形成类似的内部表征。参数规模超过百亿的模型能够推断出未明确陈述的关系，并将其泛化到合成的实体名称上。在跨模型、跨任务的实验中，模型形成了对关系结构的抽象表征，并将其与实体身份的表征以相加的方式结合。关系主要以成对链接的形式存储并进行回溯式组合，而非前瞻性地编码在一个全局坐标系中。一组稀疏且分布式的键值对中介了这种绑定机制；扰动这些键值对可以植入“虚假记忆”，从而产生可预测的行为改变。我们的发现揭示了一种类似于认知地图的保守组织结构，它支持灵活而系统的行为。
tldr: 超过百亿参数的大型语言模型会形成类似动物认知地图的抽象关系表征，关系以成对链接形式回溯式组合存储，扰动其中稀疏的键值对还能植入“虚假记忆”并引发可预测的行为变化。
en_tdlr: Large language models beyond the ten-billion-parameter scale form cognitive-map-like abstract relational representations stored as retrospectively composed pairwise links, whose sparse key-value bindings can be perturbed to implant "false memories" with predictable behavioral effects.
